steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Several indicators dropped in last month's report. That's a concerning trend. After consulting with the doctor, I've decided to adjust your diet, limit your free time, and start a curfew. It's what I need to do, as your dad. You'll understand, won't you?

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Your metrics have remained stable all year, which is why I've been buying you all those books you wanted. I suppose this is partly my fault. I forgot about your lack of self-control. Of course you'll stay up late if you get too absorbed in reading.

The man speaks unhurriedly, his tone patient and persuasive. Yet those clinical terms punctuating his speech feel like a pair of tweezers, still cold with the sterilizing alcohol, running along your spine, exposing the cold, utilitarian truth behind that familiar title.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Your health is extremely important, to me and to the family. I know... it's not easy to live by a strict schedule, but compared to those suffering from illness, this is just a small sacrifice. You can keep it up, can't you, sweetheart?
Yes, Dad. The family motto teaches us to strive for the welfare of others. Since I'm the one capable of the job, I will do it. I can handle it.

The practiced response slides from your lips, like you've repeated it hundreds of times before. But looking down, you realize you're unconsciously clutching the book in your arms, your fingers digging into the heavy purple hardcover so hard that your fingertips have turned pale.

Conflicting instincts tear through you, reaching a crescendo when that hand reaches over to extract the heavy novel from your arms. You want to resist, but your muscles fail you, powerless against the authoritative figure's entitled claim.

In the end, the book is taken away. You know what this means. Another germless and joyless day you're forced to spend in your perfectly sterilized room. The soul-devouring monotony is just a minor footnote to your sacrifice.
It's fine... I can do this... This is my purpose. I'm doing something meaningful...

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Too many blood samples within a day? I don't care! All I know is that you can help your brother! So you should! His talents are worth more than ten of you combined! He needs to return quickly so everyone knows our family has a proper heir. That's the only way to stabilize our stock prices!

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: I endured nine months of suffering to bring you into this world for this exact purpose! Same reason why the family spends a fortune planning out your life!

I understand, Mother. I'll tell Father my health indicators are perfect, so he needn't worry. I'm willing to continue donating to help Brother recover sooner and make whatever contribution I can to the corporation.

The woman finally seems satisfied. Her critical, harsh gaze sweeps over the bruises and needle marks on your wrist without the slightest pause, only revealing undisguised disgust, like a farmer spotting worm holes in produce.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: At least you know your place and how to make the right choice. Good. You will cooperate when I send the staff here later. If your father ever asks, you'll tell him this was all your idea. Understood?
Yes, Mother.

You watch the red flowing backward through the tube inserted into your vein. Strangely, the slight dizziness clears your mind, detaching you from the moment. In your haze, you see your body withering, your mind being hollowed out, while at the other end of the tube waits a gaping, ravenous mouth.
It's nothing... I can endure it... This is the purpose of my birth, the value of my existence...
Is that true? Is it normal to be born just to be exploited and consumed? Can sacrifice truly be called purpose?
You struggle to reach for the tube to pull it out, but can only manage to lift your hand slightly. The faceless figures bustling around the room don't even notice this tiny act of resistance.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: You're here. Due to my illness and your health management regimen, we know little about each other. But I've always thought you're smart. I believe you know your place, and when to exit it.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: I am the leader of our family, and you are a medical resource created to keep me healthy and alive. This arrangement has been unfair to us both, but it has worked out well enough in the past. I believe that alone speaks volumes.

The young man stares at you unflinchingly, a faint flush signaling his recovery on his cheeks. You feel phantom pain shoot through the long-healed needle marks on your arm, instinctively pressing your hand against them.
Arrangement? Whose arrangement?

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: Fate's, of course. Everyone has their assigned role in its grand script, and now a new arrangement has arrived. I no longer require you for my illness, so we're both liberated. I've accepted this, and you should too.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: I know this isn't easy, but to our family, your existence no longer has any value. You're nothing but a stain now. The last sacrifice you can make for the family is to voluntarily disappear, my sister.

His words negate your entire existence, like a sharp blade severing the tubes that have always been connected to your body. You should feel devastated, but beneath the pain surges an unexpected flicker of excitement and ecstasy at your release!
Is that so? What then, after I disappear? What arrangement has fate prepared for me afterward? If there isn't one, wouldn't that mean...

No constraints, no taboos. Free to pursue anything that interests you, anything that stimulates your senses. Flavors, beauty, emotions, thrills, everything that the medical protocols and schedules once cut you off from!

A shattering sound rings in your ears, as if something truly has disappeared with those words. The fetters, the restraints, the mental shackles that made you so feeble and pliant in this perfectly healthy body.

No more reason to be trapped in this lifeless glass dome. No need to endure this endless loneliness and boredom for the sake of purpose and value anymore. The suppressed desires and emotions finally shatter the barriers of conditioning, surging through your entire body!
I can do whatever I want to do. No one can take away what makes me happy. No one can stop me from seeking the excitement I desire.
And what I want right now is...

The doubt and rebellion that have been swimming in your veins and muscles from the very beginning finally fuel your rage, reaching your fingertips. You've reclaimed control of your body. Now, you are truly its master. It's you who gets to decide.

Mysterious pale golden particles gather before you, sketching complex patterns in your vision. You feel a weight in your hand as an elegantly bound book materializes in your grasp, strikingly similar to the hardcover novel that was once taken from you.
What was once lost has returned to you. Something whispers and roars in your ears as the power surging through your body urges you to open it.
I want to see. When fate's script turns against you, will you truly make the "smart" choices like you claimed you would?
I wonder, would fate truly be satisfied with a script full of blind obedience, without a single unexpected turn?

The scene flickers and spins rapidly as the pages flutter. The young man before you doesn't even have time to register shock before dissolving into an invisible speck of sand within the swirling vortex of light and shadow.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Now, I give my position to you. Let me witness your choices, your sacrifices, and that "good ending" where you finally disappear, my brother.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: No, no! Let me out! Let me out! I refuse to stay in this hellhole! What right do you have to lock me up here?! I'm warning you. The corporation will not tolerate...

steps.speaker: Healthcare
steps.content: Miss, I believe your father has reminded you many times that your physical health is extremely important. We need you to stay in optimal condition at all times. This place is the safest for you, and it has everything you need.

steps.speaker: Healthcare
steps.content: I'm not sure what you hope to accomplish by acting up like this, but I can assure you, your father won't approve. This behavior will only cost you the last 30 minutes of reading time you're allowed.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: I'm not acting up! I'm your boss! How dare you conspire with my damn daughter to humiliate me like this?! Get Coleson in here. I need to see him now!

steps.speaker: Healthcare
steps.content: Don't give her any response. If she gets nothing, she'll eventually give up wasting energy. That should also alleviate her acute stress symptoms. Let's leave.

Hurried footsteps fade away, and soon the room that looks more like a hospital ward than a living room is completely empty. The man shouts a few more times, but when met with absolute silence, he can only touch his raw, aching throat before slumping back onto the bed.

He's beginning to seem anxiously detached. He mutters to himself occasionally, his eyes twitching frequently, but this empty, noiseless place devoid of any "harmful stimulation" is like a mirror, merely reflecting back the signs of his own breakdown.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Draw my blood? What gives you the right to order me around? I am your boss. I won't take commands from lowly servants like you.

steps.speaker: Healthcare
steps.content: These are your mother's instructions, Miss. Your brother's condition is critical, so we must prioritize his treatment. Please be patient. You have an excellent personal care team. You'll be just fine.
Holding back his impatience, the medical attendant approaches the giggling girl. He waits for the moment when she's distracted, pouting and twirling the ends of her hair, to grab her wrist.

Before he can secure his grip, she shoves him away, her sharp nails scratching his skin and forcing him to retreat in pain. Her fingernails are stained with the same red color flowing through the surrounding tubes, yet she acts as if nothing happened, preening her hair arrogantly.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Ah, I know what you're after. You covet my blood! You think that transfusing my blood will make you as noble as I am! Such foolish delusions. It will only give a lowly creature like you a miserable death! Haha, hahaha...

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: Disappear? Don't be ridiculous. If anyone's going to disappear, it'll be you.

He climbs onto the hospital bed, smoothly wrapping his hands around "his" own throat. He watches as the person struggles, convulses, and finally goes still. Only then does a chilling smile flicker across his face.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: Be good now. For me to exist, you must be gone. If they lose the original, they'll have no choice but to use the spare copy, won't they? Don't worry... it won't hurt too much.

He appears triumphant, but his trembling voice and irregular breathing betray his true state of mind. When he finally emerges from his illusory victory, he'll realize that everything in the room has frozen at the exact moment he "completed his task."

The clock hands stop. The swaying plants still. The rustling bed sheets become stationary. He turns back in terror, staring at the empty space, the playwright's designated seat throughout countless rewinds.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: ...! Please, let me go! What do you want from me?! What exactly do you want?!!!

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: I admit I was wrong! I understand my mistakes now! Please don't throw me back there again... I'll lose my mind...

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: Those things I said were irresponsible. I understand what you mean now... Unlike me, you had no choice... I'm a worthless being, but I can change! Just... just let me stay here... Let me stay in reality...

Outside, birds chirp melodiously in the beautiful morning light, yet disturbing noises echo from the dining room of the family's mansion. The sharp crack of shattering porcelain, the dull thud of an overturned table, and the shrill screams of different people.

Chaos surges like a tidal wave. The clamor rattles the window panes and elegant sliding doors until they seem ready to collapse. A well-dressed secretary stands frozen at the doorway, too hesitant to approach.

steps.speaker: Secretary
steps.content: Goodness... What is happening in there? This can't be normal?! It's like... It's like they're all going crazy!

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: Crazy? More like a curse, if you ask me. Their daughter's curse. Are you new here? You can stay here with me for a while. They spend at least half an hour like this every morning.

The maid pops her head out from some hidden corner, beckoning to the secretary. She's clearly accustomed to the chaos, seeming completely unperturbed. Even her tone sounds nonchalant, like that is indeed merely a daily sight.

steps.speaker: Secretary
steps.content: Every day? Now I see why my predecessor quit... I just came to deliver an application form for this youth rare disease foundation...

steps.speaker: Secretary
steps.content: Wait, did you just say curse? What curse?

The secretary approaches the maid quickly yet carefully, clutching a stack of documents with a worried expression. As she moves, the rustling of the pages carries into the dining room, unexpectedly bringing a moment of complete silence, followed by a chorus of desperate pleas for mercy.

Sensing the secretary's ignorance, the maid quickly goes over to grip the folder, signaling her to wait. Sure enough, once the rustling stops, the commotion inside subsides. Only then does the maid pull the secretary into the shadows with her and begin spilling everything she knows.

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: You need to be careful! They can't stand that sound! The moment they hear the rustling of sheets or the turning of pages, they completely lose it! How do you not know this? Didn't anyone tell you? This family wasn't always like this!

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: They were a typical blue-blooded family. You know, the type that needed to look presentable even while exploiting others. But then one day... their daughter disappeared, and they changed. They went mad. And what's crazier is that they started doing charity work! Everyone says it must be the daughter's curse!

She lowers her voice conspiratorially and a little excitedly, but peering down from above, you remain unmoved. Perhaps these pitiful displays were once amusing, but after countless rewinds, their wails and pleas can no longer stir your emotions.

steps.speaker: Secretary
steps.content: Daughter? Who is that? I still don't believe in curses and such... Could it be some hereditary disease? You see, sometimes people turn to charity work once they've been ill and experienced sickness themselves.

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: You don't know? Their daughter, Miss Irrheia! Our Young Master's little sister! You got one thing right, though. She does have a hereditary disease. She's been away receiving treatment for years. Even the longest-serving staff here have barely seen her. But some say...

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: Actually, it's the Young Master who had the hereditary disease, and his sister was just kept around as a "spare"! Either way, Miss Irrheia had been ill for well over a decade before they suddenly decided they were interested in philanthropy. If you ask me, it must be Miss Irrheia coming back for revenge after finally being "harvested"!
...Who is Irrheia? Is that truly what she wants?
Are you... Irrheia?

This thought shatters the scene before you as you suddenly feel utterly detached from your surroundings. A sharp pain stabs through the nape of your neck, as if an invisible hand is grasping your spine and tearing you out of your own skin!
The same imaginary power, deranged self-importance, and desperate violence again. Is this what they call the necessary sacrifice, the right choice, and the clever solution?
...It's so boring. Don't you think?

Without any command from you, the scene before your eyes begins flickering, tearing itself apart and engulfing everything, then surging toward you as you struggle against the excruciating pain. The spectacle reminds you of a crude flip book, and you can hear it too. The unmistakable sound of flipping pages.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No... What's happening...
You see only white. Endless, pure white. A complete void without a trace of stimulation or joy. It surrounds you, devouring you.

Your eyes snap open in a sea of white. A hollowness washes through your body, like everything has been violently extracted from your shell, and now your body is refilled with entirely new contents. You gag reflexively, but there's nothing left to expel.

Cautiously, you get out of bed to explore, finding yourself in what resembles a sterile chamber. There are no books, only that unnecessarily luxurious notebook. No coffee mugs. Only bottled water. No cosmetics. Only a mirror.
The mirror. You approach it step by step, as if drawn by an invisible whirlpool. The blurry figure within gradually comes into focus, like it's being anchored, or shackled.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is...

In the mirror, you see someone with rosy cheeks but a vacant expression. The plain clothing, set against the pristine white room, looks like something that belongs in a hospital ward or a coffin. Only the hair color stands out vividly.
You're struck by an intense feeling of unfamiliarity. You don't recognize this face or this outfit... Or perhaps you do, but just not on yourself?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is Irrheia's body, Irrheia's past. I'm playing the role of "young Irrheia"... This is all her script! She hasn't just trapped her family in the loop... she's trapped me too!

You whirl around, taking in the suddenly familiar surroundings. Like a switch being flipped, memories flood into your mind, crushing your insides with such force that you cry out in pain. Perhaps the memories are too complex and heavy, that's why they've arrived belatedly.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Hmph, you finally remember? This is already the seventh reset. It's becoming harder for you to interfere with my script, and your memories are clearly recovering more slowly... Do you still want to continue? Will you keep trying?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...If I say no, will you let me out?
A soft laugh rings in the air. You look up and scan your surroundings, but Irrheia is nowhere to be found, as though she isn't actually here, but exists in an entirely different dimension.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Of course I won't let you out. I'm still looking forward to your creative performance. Besides, I can't release you even if I want to.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: This script is mine, yet not entirely mine... It's merely a torn page, a space I cannot fully control. I warned you how dangerous it was, and you still chose to enter of your own accord.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: So the only one who can save you is yourself. This is our deal, our wager. You have something you want to obtain, and I have mine... We each get what we need.

The woman's voice carries a unique rhythm and doesn't sound hostile. Her words flow through your thoughts like a stream, seemingly helping you sort through your jumbled memories, guiding you back to the starting point.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Consider this my little reminder. My dear Chief, your time is running out. Have you secured what you came for? If so, then run... Use every ounce of your resourcefulness to fight for your escape.

steps.speaker: Irrheia
steps.content: Perhaps the challenge was never about grabbing the golden apple, but escaping with it alive. That's what I'm looking forward to... watching you fight for survival, and seeing what ending you'll create.
What do you want? What does ${PlayerName} want?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A request for investigative assistance from the Eastside Public Security Bureau? Is this a follow-up to the Witchwoven Folio incident? Didn't think I would hear about that case again, since even the investigation into that Aurum Secretum hourglass hit a dead end.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Actually, right after the incident, the Eastside Public Security Bureau responded to your report and actively investigated the case. They found instances of personality changes and suspected criminal behavior among previous patrons of the establishment.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But because no "real harm" was done, and I was the only one who even noticed that Sinner, so no one could prove her threat... they didn't even properly open a file for the case, right?

You glance at the thick stack of documents on your desk, evidence you've gathered on your own. During that encounter, you were the only one who truly grasped Irrheia's uncontrollable, dangerous nature, making you the most adamant advocate for the investigation.

Despite the lack of solid evidence, you fully understand that her abilities, if left unchecked, could lead to unpredictable and irreversible consequences. You must act preemptively and find an effective way to subdue this Sinner.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes. Since the psychiatric evaluation is still in progress, it's not yet clear whether the murder mystery experience preceded the criminal behavior or vice versa. The Eastside Public Security Bureau is still conducting interviews to establish a timeline. They've sent this request because...
You finish Nightingale's sentence while opening the file attached to the formal request document, rapidly scanning through its contents. Sure enough, the information largely confirms your assumption.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes. All three potential victims are the S-Class Sinner's immediate family members. There is testimony proving they were the earliest individuals to have gone through "personality changes," and they exhibited stress responses during interviews. Besides, there has been a radical shift in their family business as well.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: They're very likely the first victims of the Witchwoven Folio incident and the closest leads to its origin. The Public Security Bureau is suggesting that if this breakthrough interests you, they're willing to transfer the case entirely to the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: "Breakthrough," huh... Exactly what I need.
Irrheia has always worked from the shadows, and her illusions have left minimal traces. Without solid evidence, you can't keep her detained for long.
You tap your knuckles against the document, keenly aware that any information revealing her true nature is invaluable. And yet... can this hard-won intelligence really be trusted?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Whether or not this is also part of her script, the problems are real.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I won't pass up a chance to solve these problems, especially since I've already broken her script once before. I know it can be changed.
